exposure: premature closure of the ductus arteriosus (idiopathic)
premature closure of the ductus arteriosus (associated with maternal NSAID exposure)
outcome: need for vasopressor and/or inotropic support
morphological anomaly of the tricuspid valve
cohort: Critically ill neonates diagnosed with premature closure of the ductus arteriosus at a single French academic medical center between 2013 and 2023.
finding: Veno-arterial ECMO support is not uncommon in critically ill neonates with premature DA closure and is associated with more pathological adaptation to extra-uterine life, greater need for vasoactive-inotropic support, and higher frequency of bi-ventricular failure or morphological anomaly of the tricuspid valve.
